newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bankgesellschaft eyes BHF Bank - paper.
newsitem.headline: Bankgesellschaft eyes BHF Bank - paper.

text.p: German newspaper Boersen Zeitung reported on Friday that Berlin-based bank Bankgesellschaft Berlin AG was interested in acquiring a majority stake in Frankfurt-based bank BHF-Bank AG.
The newspaper reported that Bankgesellschaft was considering taking a 75 percent stake in BHF Bank and that key discussions about the issue were underway.
A spokeswoman at Bankgesellschaft would neither confirm nor deny if takeover talks were underway.
German insurance giant Allianz is the largest single share holder in BHF Bank with a 15.2 percent stake. BHF Bank is said to be worth about 3.7 billion marks.
Earlier this week Bankgesellschaft Berlin AG and regional bank Norddeutsche Landesbank announced they were beginning merger talks which could create one of the country's largest banking groups.

On Tuesday BHF's newly appointed chairman Ernst Michel Kruse told the annual meeting that the bank's main shareholders would continue to support the bank's developments, indicating the bank intended its shareholder structure to remain unchanged.
